unique_rule: kappa=1 when no balanced A-block exists; otherwise kappa=2-2/b_max. Algebraically equivalent: set b*=2 if none else b_max and kappa=2-2/b*.
all_rank_reason: Each ambient vertex ±2e_i projects into exactly one component. Full C component gives gauge 1; inactive gives 0; balanced A block of size b gives gauge 2-2/b. The maximum is therefore forced and depends only on the largest balanced block.
